title: Latest F1 News

items.title: Norris in title fight 'until it's not possible' – Brown
items.content: Zak Brown believes Lando Norris is still in contention for this year's drivers' title after claiming pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix, stating "until it's not possible, it's possible".
items.contentSnippet: Zak Brown believes Lando Norris is still in contention for this year's drivers' title after claiming pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix, stating "until it's not possible, it's possible".
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 扎克·布朗表示，拉ando·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛中夺得杆位后，仍具备争夺本赛季车手总冠军的可能性，并强调“只要有可能，就有可能”。
summaries.en: Zak Brown confirms Lando Norris remains in the title race following his pole position at the Spanish Grand Prix. He states, "until it's not possible, it's possible," emphasizing Norris's continued contention for the drivers' championship.
